3403.title: Service-tier selection has no standalone persistence path
3403.rootCauseOneLine: The composer changes local tier state without saving it; the thread-update schema lacks serviceTier, and Codex conversion omits default from JSON.
3403.proposedFix: Add supported persistence for the existing tier control, synchronize execution-option state, and verify explicit default-tier reset behavior with Codex. This exceeds the autopilot public-schema and single-subsystem limits.
3403.caveats: Unit and source-level reproduction only. Browser navigation, reload, and a live Codex default-tier reset were not executed. Null reset semantics remain a live-provider verification item.
